description: Get the buying committee DealMap for a prospect company. DealMaps are held at corporate-family grain: a subsidiary ticker resolves upward to the family's DealMap and the response names the family. Shows stakeholders with AI-assigned roles (Economic Buyer, Decision Maker, Champion, Executive Sponsor, Evaluator, Blocker, etc.), org hierarchy edges, and a buying_committee_summary identifying the top pick for each role. Each stakeholder carries placement: "placed" (in the reporting hierarchy) or "unplaced" (listed at the company but not placed in the hierarchy; reporting line unknown, no edges implied — added when the placed chart is sparse). Use this to understand who is involved in the purchase decision. Free operation. Returns status "empty" if no DealMap has been generated yet — call generate_dealmap first.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (subsidiary tickers resolve to the corporate family)

name: get_dealmap
